sources.snippet: An open Macedonian language model — and the data-quality research that produced it. Named after Свети Климент Охридски — St. Clement of Ohrid, who taught at the Ohrid Literary School in the 9th century.

Gemma 4 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 12B is trained from scratch based on a new, unified, and encoder-free model paradigm, replacing the separate vision and audio encoders with lightweight projection modules.

sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.
